title: AAI Junior Executive & Manager Online Form 2026 – Start
vacancyDetails: 389 posts: Manager 260 + Junior Executive 129 across Civil, Electrical, Finance, IT, Architecture, Law, Fire Services, Operations, Commercial and other disciplines (Advt. No. 12/2026/CHQ/DR-CBT)
qualification: Post-wise: BE/B.Tech, MBA, CA/ICWA/CFA, Law degree, Architecture, Mass Communication, M.Sc. GIS/Geoinformatics etc. as per post. Manager posts generally require 3 years post-qualification experience; Junior Executive posts are open to freshers (as per notification).
ageLimit: Manager: 18–32 years; Junior Executive: 18–27 years (as on 07 Sep 2026). SC/ST +5 yrs, OBC-NCL +3 yrs, PwBD +10 yrs, Ex-Servicemen as per rules.
applicationFee: ₹1000 (incl. GST) for General/EWS/OBC (Male). SC, ST, PwBD, Women and eligible AAI Apprentices – Nil / exempted.
selectionProcess: Manager (most posts): CBT → Interview → DV → Medical. Manager (Fire Services): CBT → PMT → Driving Test → PET → DV → Medical. Junior Executive: CBT → DV → Medical.
documentsRequired: Passport photo, signature, left thumb impression, handwritten declaration, educational certificates, experience certificate (Manager), category certificate if applicable, valid ID proof, LMV licence where required (Operations / Fire Services)
howToApply:
1. Visit https://www.aai.aero (Careers)
2. Open Advt. No. 12/2026/CHQ/DR-CBT – Managers & Junior Executives
3. Register with valid email and mobile
4. Fill application, upload photo/sign/documents
5. Pay fee (if applicable) and submit by 07 September 2026
6. Download / print application for future use
shortDescription: AAI Junior Executive & Manager Online Form 2026 for 389 posts. Apply online from 08 August 2026 to 07 September 2026 at aai.aero.
content:
Airports Authority of India (AAI) has released the notification for Direct Recruitment of Managers and Junior Executives under Advt. No. 12/2026/CHQ/DR-CBT.

Total vacancies: 389 (Manager – 260 | Junior Executive – 129). Online application starts on 08 August 2026 and closes on 07 September 2026.

Quick Summary

  • Start Date: 08 August 2026
  • Last Date: 07 September 2026
  • Total Posts: 389
  • Apply: Online only at aai.aero Careers
  • Selection: CBT (and Interview / Physical stages post-wise)

Vacancy Break-up (indicative)

  • Manager (Engg-Civil) – 145
  • Manager (Engg-Elect) – 16
  • Manager (Finance) – 34
  • Manager (IT) – 5
  • Manager (Architecture) – 4
  • Manager (Law) – 2
  • Manager (Fire Services) – 14
  • Manager (Operations) – 28
  • Manager (Commercial) – 9
  • Manager (Corporate Planning & MS) – 1
  • Manager (Corporate Communications) – 2
  • Junior Executive (Finance) – 36
  • Junior Executive (Law) – 6
  • Junior Executive (Operations) – 79
  • Junior Executive (Survey & Cartography) – 8

Pay Scale / CTC (approx.)

  • Manager (E-3): ₹60,000 – 3% – ₹1,80,000 (approx. CTC ~ ₹21 lakh p.a.)
  • Junior Executive (E-1): ₹40,000 – 3% – ₹1,40,000 (approx. CTC ~ ₹14 lakh p.a.)

Age Limit (as on 07/09/2026)

  • Manager: 18 to 32 years
  • Junior Executive: 18 to 27 years
  • Category-wise upper age relaxation as per Government / AAI rules

Application Fee

  • General / EWS / OBC (Male): ₹1,000
  • SC / ST / PwBD / Women / eligible AAI Apprentices: Exempted

How to Apply

Apply only through the official website https://www.aai.aero → Careers → registration link against Advt. No. 12/2026/CHQ/DR-CBT. Keep photo, signature, documents and fee ready. Always verify final eligibility, vacancy and dates from the official notification PDF.
